bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నా ఆశ్రయము, నా కేడెము నా హృదయము ఆయనయందు నమి్మకయుంచెన గనుక నాకు సహాయము కలిగెను. కావున నా హృదయము ప్రహర్షించుచున్నది కీర్తనలతో నేను ఆయనను స్తుతించుచున్నాను.
bible_verses.english: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

bible_verses.telugu: దేవుడు నాకు ఎత్తయిన కోటగాను కృపగల దేవుడుగాను ఉన్నాడు నా బలమా, నిన్నే కీర్తించెదను.
bible_verses.english: You are my strength, I sing praise to you; you, God, are my fortress, the God on whom I can rely.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నాకు ఎత్తయిన కోట నా దేవుడు నాకు ఆశ్రయదుర్గము.
bible_verses.english: But the Lord has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my ultimate refuge and the strength of my soul. When I feel overwhelmed or alone, help me to remember that Your love actively defends me day and night. You are the deep well I draw from when my own strength runs dry. Fill my heart with Your peace today, and teach me to rest securely in Your constant, faithful presence. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my ultimate refuge and the strength of my soul. When I feel overwhelmed or alone, help me to remember that Your love actively defends me day and night. You are the deep well I draw from when my own strength runs dry. Fill my heart with Your peace today, and teach me to rest securely in Your constant, faithful presence. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings battles that leave us feeling weary and isolated, but we never face them unguarded. Jesus is not just our refuge; His unfailing love actively surrounds and protects us in every season. When anxiety or loneliness whispers that we are on our own, this song invites us to draw deeply from the well of His presence and remember that He fights for us. Today, rest in the quiet confidence that the Lord is your constant defender and strength.
